user.description: Use the credentials for the admin web portal. See the documentation for setup details.

data.device_list_interval: Seconds between Deco status updates (0 = startup only)
data.consider_home: Seconds to wait before marking a device tracker as not home after it is no longer seen.
data.use_https: Use HTTPS (allow automatic HTTP to HTTPS upgrade)
data.link_client_devices: Link client trackers to devices by MAC address
data.expose_wifi_ssids: Show WiFi network names on the WiFi status sensors

data_description.use_https: Enabled permits a same-router HTTPS upgrade. Disabled sends requests only over HTTP; routers that require HTTPS cannot connect. Verify SSL controls certificate checking separately.

reauth_confirm.description: Problem with login credentials. This may be caused by logging in on a separate device. See the documentation for login requirements.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Select a polling interval of 10, 30, 60, or 120 seconds.
error.invalid_device_list_interval: Enter 0 for startup-only, or at least 10 seconds for Deco status updates.
error.invalid_expose_wifi_ssids: Select on or off to control WiFi network name exposure.
error.invalid_use_https: Select on or off for HTTPS transport.
error.invalid_host_scheme: Enter a valid http:// or https:// router address without path, credentials or query.
error.http_only_requires_http: HTTP-only mode requires an http:// address.
error.https_required: This Deco requires HTTPS. Enable Use HTTPS to connect.
error.unsafe_redirect: The Deco returned an unsafe or unsupported redirect. Check the router address.
